core_idea: The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael is a Tank / Status Specialist / Support — **Bleed** and **Burn** stacking — damage and clash power scale off the combined count on the target. Support passive (**Hey, Are Ya Into Fixers, Too?**) keys off **deployment order** — set your main carry as #1 deployed before the fight.
playstyle_guide:
- **Hey, Are Ya Into Fixers, Too?** watches the **#1 deployed ally** — arrange the dashboard so the intended carry is first in line.
- Skills check **6+ Burn** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Skills check **6+ Bleed** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Front-load **+5 Aggro** on the slot you want enemies to target.
- Pair high-Aggro turns with Guard or Assist Defense so passives trigger under pressure.
- At Combat Start at 6+ Envy Resonance, **Counter: I'll Get You Back for This, Man** can fire **Violet~ Breaking Slam** as a Counter instead of a normal defensive clash — the defense slot is your burst tool, not just protection.

**S1 — Totally Badass Ass-kicking** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If target has 6+ (Burn + Bleed), Coin Power +1 | [On Use] Heal 5 SP.

**S2 — Crossing Dervish** (BP 4, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If target has 6+ (Burn + Bleed), Coin Power +1 | [Combat Start] This Skill gains Offense Level by (highest Reson. / 2) (max 3.
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits

**S3 — Violet~ Breaking Slam** (BP 4, CP +3, x4): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If target has 6+ (Burn + Bleed), Coin Power +1 | [Combat Start] This Skill gains Offense Level by (highest Reson. / 2) (max 3.
- Deal (Envy Reson. x 5)% of this Coin's final damage as Slash bonus damage (max 30%); [On Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed

Combat passive — **Thermal Weapon**: This unit is considered as an "Identity that inflicts Burn and Bleed".
  - If this unit has Thermal Blades, Skills that inflict Bleed are considered as Skills that inflict both Burn and Bleed.

Combat passive — **The Middle Never Forgets, Y'know?**: Turn End: Inflict Vengeance Mark to the enemy that dealt the most Skill damage to an ally this turn.
  - Every time this unit is hit by an enemy, gain 2 The Middle — Grudge (Ishmael) (2 times per turn).
  - When another -faction ally is hit by an enemy, gain 1 The Middle — Grudge (Ishmael) (once per turn per Identity).

Defense skill — **Counter: I'll Get You Back for This, Man**: [Combat Start] At 6+ sum of Envy A-Reson., use 'Violet~ Breaking Slam' as Counter.
  - (Activates from the leftmost Skill Slot. Activates 2 times per turn).
  - [Combat Start] Gain 25% of missing HP as Shield (once per turn).
